report.answer: During registration, insertChild (tree.go:288) detects `:name` segments via findWildcard (tree.go:255) and creates a dedicated child node with nType=param whose `path` field stores the wildcard name (e.g. ":name"), setting parent.wildChild=true. During matching, getValue (tree.go:418) detects the wildChild flag, jumps to that child (n.children[len-1]), and in the `case param:` branch (~tree.go:490) scans the remaining path up to the next '/' or end-of-string to find the param's end, then appends a Param{Key: n.path[1:], Value: matchedSegment} to the *params slice (optionally URL-unescaping if `unescape` is set), before continuing the walk deeper or returning handlers.

verified.summary: insertChild creates a param-type child node named after the wildcard for ':name' segments
findWildcard locates ':' or '*' prefixed segments and validates naming
getValue follows n.wildChild to the last child and dispatches on nType
param case scans to next '/' or path end, strips 'n.path[1:]' as Key, slices path[:end] as Value, appends to *value.params
unescape flag triggers url.QueryUnescape on the captured value
catchAll ('*name') wildcards captured similarly but consume rest of path

relevantFiles.reason: insertChild builds param/catchAll nodes; getValue captures param values into Params during lookup
